reason: Not refuted, and one number needs correcting. The finding is a negative verdict: do not build before R8, and park the idea under I-079. That verdict holds. I re-aggregated the scratchpad r11_graph_arms_out.json (56 exp60 clips, arms[*].row). The division counts match the scan: base 25/31/74 (divJ 0.1923), mirror 32/231/67, nearest 42/729/57, oracle-FP 25/0/74. With score = adjEdgeJ + 0.1*divJ on pooled counts (the edge side is negligible here, ~17 TP edges out of ~40k), a perfect filter on the gated pool gives +0.0054, as claimed, so the idea fails the ~+0.012 bar even as an oracle. The error: on the wide pool (17 TP) the finding says the bar needs precision >= ~50%. That is too lenient. At 50% precision the gain is +0.0093. It is +0.0114 at 70% and +0.0121 at 80%, so +0.012 needs >= ~79% precision with all 17 TP kept, >= ~93% with 16 kept, and cannot be reached with <= 15 kept. From a 2.4% base rate that is a ~33x precision gain (odds ~150x). Cues with a single-feature AUC of 0.73 (I-056, old base, ranker never measured) or precision 4-15% (I-076) cannot deliver it. Value on private is worse still: the pool TPs come almost entirely from 6bba (44b6 clips add ~0 TP in the nearest arm), and the 1/6 lab-to-LB transfer applies on top. Feasibility also fails. It needs raw train-zarr crops, about half a day of new code, a dummy and a new user OK before 27 Sep 12:00 UTC, which does not fit R8. This is not a closed line in disguise (it is I-047's pool plus an image filter), but it is dominated by the post-deadline learned far-daughter slot (I-079), as the finding says.

At 50% precision it gives +0.0093 and at 30% +0.0055. From a 2.4% base that is ~33x precision / ~150x odds enrichment'. Add: the pool TPs come almost entirely from 6bba (44b6 contributes ~0), so the transfer to hidden embryos is unknown.
realistic_gain: 0 for the finals: not buildable before R8, and even an oracle filter gives at most +0.0054 lab on the gated pool (about +0.001 public at the 1/6 transfer). A realistic image filter (precision <= ~15%) is about 0 to negative (-0.0007 at 15% on the wide pool). Its value is documentation only: a quantitative ceiling for post-deadline item 6.
